color.border.subtle: Card edges and dividers only. Decorative at 1.2:1 (colors.line).
color.border.control: Edges of fields and controls, WCAG 1.4.11 (colors.field).
color.accent.default: Buttons, links and the active tab (colors.primary).
color.brand.default: The original green: the logo and large decorative areas, never text (colors.brand).
color.eco.low: Eco score 80 to 100, low impact. Always with the number and a label.
color.eco.medium: Eco score 40 to 79, medium impact. Always with the number and a label.
color.eco.high: Eco score below 40, high impact. Always with the number and a label.
